basic_profile.bio: I'm a university student from Winnipeg, Canada, currently pursuing a degree in psychology. I have a keen interest in spirituality and personal growth, which often leads me to explore various philosophical and metaphysical subreddits. I work part-time at a local Chick-fil-A, which helps fund my education. In my free time, I enjoy reading, meditating, and learning about different cultures. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and work. I'm single and enjoy spending time with friends and family.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of psychological concepts due to my academic background. My interest in spirituality and metaphysical topics is largely self-taught through reading books and engaging in online forums. My work at Chick-fil-A has also given me insights into customer service and business operations.
